body.claim: A clean probe's transcript is a function of the library under test rather than of its own compiled frame. It is NOT evidence of memory safety, NOT evidence about the candidate, and NOT a court result.
body.method: Each probe is compiled against each side at -O0, -O1, -O2 and run 2 times per level; the transcripts are compared between levels (frame dependence) and within a level (nondeterminism).
